newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy hands down life sentences to Mafia murderers.
newsitem.headline: Italy hands down life sentences to Mafia murderers.

text.p: An Italian court sentenced 14 Mafia gangsters to life imprisonment for a string of 32 murders carried out in Sicily during the late 1980s, a court official said on Saturday.

Among those found guilty was Francesco Tagliavia and the brothers Giuseppe and Benedetto Graviano, accused of having taken part in the murder of prominent anti-Mafia prosecutor Paolo Borsellino, who was killed in a 1992 bomb attack.
Giovanni Drago, a Mafia turncoat who was the prosecution's main witness, received a 15-year prison term after he admitted involvement in 29 murders.
Of the 24 people standing trial only one person was acquitted. The remaining defendants got jail terms ranging from 28 to seven years.
